\providecommand{\EFourData}{e4}
\pgfplotstableset{col sep=comma}
\begin{tikzpicture}

    name=e4approachpos, width=0.92\textwidth, height=3.6cm,

    xmin=-0.15, xmax=5.95, unbounded coords=jump]
  \addplot[blue!70!black, thick, const plot mark right] table[x=t, y=pos] {\EFourData/lead/approach_double_s.csv};

  \addplot[red!70!black, const plot mark right] table[x=t, y=vel] {\EFourData/lead/approach_linear.csv};
